page.layout: One printed title page, centred. Red and black type in the upper part, a woodcut engraving (Minerva with a banner) in the middle with its caption beneath, and the imprint in red and black at the foot. No running head, page number, catchword or signature.

main_text.l: & in Academia Lugdunensi Juris Professoris Primarii,
Et nunc demum perpetuis Notis & brevibus additamentis, tam
theoricis quam practicis, ex optimis quibusque Auctoribus,
ipsisque legibus passim aucta, correcta,& distincte edita,

l.i: Tit. Dig. & Decret. de Verb. Signif. & Reg.

main_text.l: Ex Officinâ RVDOLPHI à ZYLL, Bibliopolæ.

page.notes: The engraving shows Minerva seated beside a tree, with a snake and a banner. The banner text is largely illegible, so it is marked as illegible above. The library stamp "Koninklijke Bibliotheek 's Gravenhage" (printed in the image as "'s Hage"), the handwritten shelf marks at top right, and the digitiser's footer were left out. The date reads cIↄ Iↄ c LXXXVI in the original, transcribed as MDCLXXXVI. Red type is not marked separately.
